title: N3XORA v2: Open-Source Bioinformatics and Computational Research Platform
description: N3XORA v2 is an open-source, self-hostable research platform that brings together DNA/RNA sequence analysis, molecular structure and docking workflows, scientific provenance, and evidence management. Its N3XORA-Sahel domain extends the platform to African natural-product and phytochemical research, including LC-MS/MS data-processing and curation workflows. The software uses FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis, Docker, RDKit, AutoDock Vina, OpenMS and related scientific tools. Computational outputs and heuristic scores are exploratory evidence: they do not establish experimental bioactivity, therapeutic efficacy, safety, or clinical validity. PostgreSQL concurrency validation of the ResearchStudy lifecycle is planned as a subsequent development step.
